# Consolidated agent reference

This maintained entry file points to canonical documentation; it is intentionally not a copied snapshot. A copied full-document bundle would silently become stale. Use the repository tree or build the MkDocs site to retrieve complete content.

## Essential rules

- M3 Expressive is an evolution and extension of Material 3, not an inference that every M3 component has an expressive variant.
- Flutter's Material 3 support and `useMaterial3` do not establish complete M3 Expressive behavior.
- Use authoritative source evidence; distinguish Material guidance, Flutter API facts, and local implementation decisions.
- Do not invent values or report untested support/compliance.
- Implement responsive and accessible behavior for actual target platforms and input types.

## Canonical pages

- Scope: `docs/getting-started/scope.md`
- Foundation index: `docs/foundations/index.md`
- Component index: `docs/components/index.md`
- Flutter implementation: `docs/flutter/index.md`
- Platform overview: `docs/platforms/index.md`
- Source catalog: `docs/reference/official-sources.md`
- Support matrix: `docs/reference/support-matrix.md`
- Component verification ledger: `docs/reference/component-verification-ledger.md`
- Phase 0/1 audit and 38-entry inventory: `docs/reference/m3e-phase0-1-audit.md`, `docs/reference/m3e-master-component-inventory.csv`, `docs/reference/m3e-master-component-inventory.json`, `docs/reference/m3e-source-evidence-ledger.csv`
- Agent workflow and checklist: `docs/ai-agent-guide/implementation-workflow.md`, `docs/ai-agent-guide/validation-checklist.md`
- Full machine-facing index: `llms.txt`

Do not manually duplicate these pages into this file. Update the canonical documents and this concise index together as needed.
